s.t:
Objetivo Del Puesto
Brindar apoyo administrativo y operativo a las diferentes áreas de la organización, asegurando el control documental, la coordinación de actividades y el seguimiento de procesos administrativos.
Principales Funciones
Gestión y organización de documentación física y digital.
Elaboración y control de expedientes, reportes y documentos administrativos.
Atención de correos, llamadas y seguimiento a solicitudes internas.
Coordinación de agendas, reuniones y actividades administrativas.
Apoyo en procesos de facturación, control de pagos y gestión de suministros.
Actualización de información en sistemas administrativos y apoyo en actividades asignadas.
Requisitos
Estudios universitarios en Administración de Empresas, Contaduría Pública, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines (en curso o finalizados).
De 1 a 3 años de experiencia en puestos administrativos o de asistencia.
Manejo intermedio de Microsoft Office (Excel, Word y PowerPoint).
Experiencia en gestión documental, elaboración de reportes y atención al cliente interno.
Deseable conocimiento en sistemas ERP y procesos básicos de facturación.
Condiciones
Contrato por proyecto de 3 meses.
Modalidad 100% remoto
Horario de oficina.
Lunes a viernes

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Office Manager plays a critical role in delivering a seamless and welcoming office experience by coordinating daily office operations, supporting local leaders and employees, and ensuring the office is prepared to enable great work, connection, and gathering.
This role partners closely with the country manager and several teams to ensure the office remains an effective, connected, and highly functional workplace. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience.

The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life.
This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected.
This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings.

As an Office Manager, you help bring Airbnb's culture to life through exceptional execution and service.
You will coordinate daily office operations, support local leaders, facilitate gatherings and leadership visits, and serve as a trusted resource for employees and visitors. Through strong organization, hospitality, and attention to detail, you help create an office experience that feels welcoming, seamless, and connected.
Success in this role requires excellent judgment, strong relationship-building skills, operational rigor, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they impact the employee experience.

Support the Office Experience
Help ensure the office is welcoming, organized, and operationally ready each day.
Serve as a visible and approachable presence for employees, visitors, and guests.
Support day-to-day workplace experience programs and services.
Monitor office needs and proactively address issues or escalate to global and regional counterparts as needed.
Help maintain hospitality standards across office spaces, meeting rooms, and shared environments.
Coordinate Office Operations
Support the daily coordination of workplace operations, hospitality services, food programs, and office amenities.
Partner with vendors and service providers to ensure consistent delivery of services and timely issue resolution.
Monitor workplace conditions and employee feedback.
Track office requests, operational issues, and follow-up actions.
Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate recommendations to regional leader and global ops team.
Maintain office documentation, communications, and operational processes.
Support implementation of office standards and playbooks.
Support office utilization reporting.
Leadership & Administrative Support
Serve as a trusted admin partner to the Country Manager.
Provide calendar booking support, meeting coordination and room scheduling support for the Country Manager.
Partner with executive administrative partners to coordinate logistics for leadership visits, executive meetings, and business gatherings.
Serve as a local resource for employees and leaders navigating office services and resources.
This role is not responsible for travel booking, expense management. This role only supports Country Manager diary/calendar support.
Support Gatherings & Connection
Coordinate logistics for local gatherings, leadership visits, and employee engagement activities.
Support gatherings, leadership visits and employee engagement activities across the region as needed.
Partner with the Workplace Operations team and Regional Gathering Manager to support successful delivery of events and connection moments.
Ensure meeting spaces, hospitality elements, vendors, and attendee experiences are prepared and executed effectively.
Support the delivery of connection and community-building experiences within the office by following global guidance and toolkits, while adapting them to local needs.
Build Strong Relationships
Develop positive working relationships with employees, leaders, Executive Assistants, vendors, and cross-functional partners.
Support a culture of hospitality, responsiveness, and service.
Gather employee feedback and share insights to improve the office experience.
Help foster an environment where employees feel welcomed, informed, and connected.
Your Expertise
5+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, hospitality, events, administration, employee experience, or related fields.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
Experience coordinating meetings, events, leadership visits, or workplace programs.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Hospitality mindset with a passion for creating positive experiences.
Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.
Experience partnering with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.
Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish.
This position needs to be based in the Mexico City office 5 days a week.

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates.

A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ airbnb.com or @ ext.airbnb.com email addresses.

Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process.

We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX

Cloudflare is looking for a bright, proactive, and detail-oriented Senior Administrative Assistant to support two leaders in our Developer GTM organization, the VP, Developer Revenue & VP, Growth. We are looking for a dynamic and dedicated candidate who is comfortable with multi-tasking and prioritization in a fast-speed environment with close attention to detail, accuracy, and timeliness.

As a seasoned, experienced professional, you will work on problems of diverse scope, demonstrate good judgment in selecting methods, and network effectively with senior personnel across the organization.

· Calendar & Conflict Management: Proactively manage complex calendars with a strong understanding of business priorities. Independently resolve most scheduling conflicts and anticipate meeting requests and logistical needs before they are explicitly stated.

· Travel & Logistics: Independently manage and coordinate complex international and domestic travel, including visa and passport needs, as well as end-to-end logistical arrangements.

· Executive Support & Business Context: Develop a deeper understanding of the managers' roles and the broader business context. Serve as a trusted gatekeeper who can confidently answer routine questions on behalf of the executives.

· Expense & Meeting Coordination: Prepare and manage expense reports, and coordinate both internal and external meeting needs with precision.

· Projects & Process Improvement: Contributes significantly to ad-hoc/special projects. Recognize where operational processes can be improved and actively suggest and implement those process improvements.

· Event Planning: Coordinate and assist with event planning as needed.

· Leadership & Influence: Act as an informal mentor to junior admins and begin to influence and improve team-wide processes.

·

· 3+ of experience as an Administrative Assistant.

· Scope & Judgment: A seasoned professional with proven experience handling problems of diverse scope and demonstrating excellent judgment in selecting administrative and operational methods.

· Proactiveness & Autonomy: Strong sense of urgency, proactiveness, and the ability to manage your own time with limited or no supervision—hitting the ground running to take charge of the position.

· Communication & Networking: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to network and build strong relationships with senior personnel.

· Organizational Skills: Exceptional organizational skills and an elite attention to detail.

· Mindset: A "no task is too small" attitude combined with the strategic mindset needed to anticipate executive needs.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

· Medical/Rx Insurance

· Dental Insurance

· Vision Insurance

· Flexible Spending Accounts

· Commuter Spending Accounts

· Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

· On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

· Global Travel Medical Insurance

· Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

· Life & Accident Insurance

· 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

· Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

· Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

· Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Internal organisation and steering. You run the CEO's operating rhythm. Calendar, inbox triage, meeting preparation, and follow-through all sit with you. You keep an eye on details and you keep the leadership cadence (weeklies, board preparation, offsites) moving.

Admin. You manage expenses and finance admin and can support with occasional personal assistant (PA) duties as needed.
CEO office collaboration. You’ll work in very close coordination with the CEO office, which includes a Chief of Staff and CEO Office Manager who are responsible for operational processes in the CEO office. Incl. performance management, KPI tracking, leadership accountability and strategic projects.
You Might Be a Fit If…
You have previously supported a CEO or equivalent in a demanding organisation and are looking for another environment that gives you an opportunity to grow.
You want to be in a young, fast company. You are comfortable with ambiguity, short timelines and a team that is still writing its own playbook, and you would rather shape the system than inherit a finished one.
You are mission-driven. You care that European companies build and adopt AI, and you want your work to count toward that rather than toward a job title. You are eager to automate your own work where possible.
AI can do a lot of things, but in the short term, it won't be able to shepherd a growing group of mostly young people in a very dynamic environment. We are looking for someone who can foster the most important human qualities within the organization.
We are looking for a long-term partner, not someone optimizing for their next role.
Personified calmness – You bring order, not chaos. When things get hectic, you're the person who slows down, thinks clearly, and helps others do the same. Your presence makes people feel like things are under control. You instill calmness and continuity in the organization.

Compassionate and empathetic – You care about the people around you. You understand that behind every missed deadline or dropped ball is a human with hidden context. You hold people accountable with kindness.
Ownership mentality – You see problems and fix them without being asked. You don't wait for permission. You follow through.

Trustworthy – You'll have access to everything and work directly with the CEO. Discretion and trust are very important.
You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

🌍 About Outpost
Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.
Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.
Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

We're hiring a second Executive Assistant to support our CEO.
We already have an EA, and she isn't going anywhere. You'll report to the CEO and work alongside her: she keeps inbound, customer routing and the investor-facing side, takes diary, travel, logistics, internal admin, and hiring coordination. You'll join to take a defined set of workstreams off that plate.
Roughly 70% of this role is executive support. The other 30% is hiring - and that's where the leverage is. We run a five-stage interview loop across engineering, ops, product, GTM and tax, hiring around two people a month. Someone needs to own the machinery: scheduling across five calendars and four countries, keeping candidates warm, chasing feedback, making sure nobody good goes cold because a diary didn't line up.
This is a role for someone early in their career who is unusually organised and wants to learn how a company actually gets built. You won't be handed a finished process. You'll be shown how we do things today, and expected to make it better.

Track and chase the follow-ups nobody wrote down
Do the work he never sees

Do the quiet prep - background on a person he's meeting, what was agreed last time, the numbers checked before a deck goes out
Anticipate. If a trip is booked, the transfer, the dinner and the buffer around the flight are already handled
The fewer questions he has to ask you, the better you're doing the job

Keep the pipeline clean: trackers, interview feedback, stage-by-stage conversion

Keep the company running

Spot the recurring problem and fix it permanently rather than solving it again next week

Da Qualität, Komfort und Effektivität bei uns besonders grossgeschrieben werden, können Patientinnen und Patienten ihre Gesundheit einfach, schnell und sicher selbst in die Hand nehmen. Unser Anspruch ist es, künftige Anforderungen im Gesundheitswesen zu prognostizieren.

Bei der Entwicklung unserer Lösungen und Arzneimittel setzen wir auf ein hohes Mass an Zuverlässigkeit und Effizienz und kümmern uns um die komplexen Themen, damit unsere Kundinnen und Kunden sich entspannt zurücklehnen können.

Offene Kommunikation und Empathie stehen bei uns an erster Stelle. Dabei versuchen wir stets, einen gemeinsamen Nenner zu finden und somit Kompromisse zu vermeiden.
Unsere Leidenschaft bei Zur Rose besteht darin, die Welt positiv zu beeinflussen. Teilst du dieselben Werte und möchtest auch du das Leben der Menschen verbessern? Dann würden wir uns freuen, dich als Teil unseres Teams zu begrüssen.

Chez Zur Rose, nous nous engageons à faire la différence dans la vie des personnes en fournissant des solutions pharmaceutiques innovantes et efficaces. Notre équipe de 500 collaborateurs, avec notre siège à Frauenfeld, partage un objectif commun: améliorer l-avenir des soins de santé.
En donnant la priorité à la qualité, au confort et à l-efficacité, nous permettons aux patients de prendre leur santé en main aisément, rapidement et en toute sécurité.
Nous nous efforçons d-anticiper les besoins en matière de soins de santé et de fournir des solutions avec une fiabilité et une efficacité exceptionnelles.
Nous nous chargeons en outre des aspects complexes pour notre clientèle afin de la soulager.
Notre culture favorise le travail d-équipe transversal.

Nous accordons une importance capitale à la transparence de la communication et à l-empathie, et veillons à trouver des consensus qui ne sent pas de simples compromis.
Chez Zur Rose, il nous tient à cœur d-avoir un impact positif sur le monde.

The Office Manager plays a critical role in delivering a seamless and welcoming office experience by coordinating daily office operations, supporting local leaders and employees, and ensuring the office is prepared to enable great work, connection, and gathering.
This role partners closely with the country manager and several teams to ensure the office remains an effective, connected, and highly functional workplace. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience.

The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life.
This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected.
This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings.

As an Office Manager, you help bring Airbnb's culture to life through exceptional execution and service.
You will coordinate daily office operations, support local leaders, facilitate gatherings and leadership visits, and serve as a trusted resource for employees and visitors. Through strong organization, hospitality, and attention to detail, you help create an office experience that feels welcoming, seamless, and connected.
Success in this role requires excellent judgment, strong relationship-building skills, operational rigor, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they impact the employee experience.

Support the Office Experience
Help ensure the office is welcoming, organized, and operationally ready each day.
Serve as a visible and approachable presence for employees, visitors, and guests.
Support day-to-day workplace experience programs and services.
Monitor office needs and proactively address issues or escalate to global and regional counterparts as needed.
Help maintain hospitality standards across office spaces, meeting rooms, and shared environments.
Coordinate Office Operations
Support the daily coordination of workplace operations, hospitality services, food programs, and office amenities.
Partner with vendors and service providers to ensure consistent delivery of services and timely issue resolution.
Monitor workplace conditions and employee feedback.
Track office requests, operational issues, and follow-up actions.
Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate recommendations to regional leader and global ops team.
Maintain office documentation, communications, and operational processes.
Support implementation of office standards and playbooks.
Support office utilization reporting.
Leadership & Administrative Support
Serve as a trusted admin partner to the Country Manager.
Provide calendar booking support, meeting coordination and room scheduling support for the Country Manager.
Partner with executive administrative partners to coordinate logistics for leadership visits, executive meetings, and business gatherings.
Serve as a local resource for employees and leaders navigating office services and resources.
This role is not responsible for travel booking, expense management. This role only supports Country Manager diary/calendar support.
Support Gatherings & Connection
Coordinate logistics for local gatherings, leadership visits, and employee engagement activities.
Support gatherings, leadership visits and employee engagement activities across the region as needed.
Partner with the Workplace Operations team and Regional Gathering Manager to support successful delivery of events and connection moments.
Ensure meeting spaces, hospitality elements, vendors, and attendee experiences are prepared and executed effectively.
Support the delivery of connection and community-building experiences within the office by following global guidance and toolkits, while adapting them to local needs.
Build Strong Relationships
Develop positive working relationships with employees, leaders, Executive Assistants, vendors, and cross-functional partners.
Support a culture of hospitality, responsiveness, and service.
Gather employee feedback and share insights to improve the office experience.
Help foster an environment where employees feel welcomed, informed, and connected.
Your Expertise
5+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, hospitality, events, administration, employee experience, or related fields.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
Experience coordinating meetings, events, leadership visits, or workplace programs.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Hospitality mindset with a passion for creating positive experiences.
Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.
Experience partnering with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.
Full professional proficiency in English and Hindi.
This position needs to be based in the Gurugram office 5 days a week.

* **Newsletters** : vous les rédigez, les mettez en page et les envoyez via Brevo. Il y en a beaucoup, et c'est un vrai terrain de copywriting.
* **Vidéo** : vous allez sur les sites filmer et photographier avec un smartphone, puis vous montez des formats courts dans CapCut. Une ou deux fois par an, un événement se joue le samedi et vous êtes sur place quelques heures.
* **Réseaux sociaux** : programmation, publication, jeux concours, réponses à la communauté.
* **Campagnes ads** : vous mettez en place et suivez les campagnes Meta, Google et TikTok Ads. Si vous ne les maîtrisez pas encore, nous vous formons.
* **Résultats** : deux à trois fois par an, vous présentez les chiffres devant le client et la direction, avec des slides claires, et vous proposez la suite.
L'IA fait partie du quotidien : ChatGPT, Claude et les outils de création de contenu vous aident à produire plus vite et à relire mieux. Nous vous montrons notre façon de travailler avec.
**Votre semaine type**
Le lundi, une vingtaine de demandes vous attendent, venues de responsables différents : un montage pour jeudi, un visuel de concours, une newsletter pour mardi, deux appels à passer.

Vous mettez tout dans votre board, vous séparez l'urgent de l'important, vous lancez la stagiaire sur ce qu'elle peut faire immédiatement, vous rappelez les deux responsables dont le brief est incomplet, et à 10h vous savez ce que vous livrez ce soir, demain et vendredi.

Le reste de la semaine, vous produisez, vous validez, vous publiez, et vous allez sur un site prendre des images. À Pâques, à la rentrée, au Black Friday et à Noël, tout arrive simultanément et le rythme monte ; le reste de l'année est régulier.
**Le profil que l-on recherche**
Chez vous, les chaussures sont rangées, la liste de courses est faite avant d'entrer dans le magasin, et un rendez-vous noté est un rendez-vous tenu. Ce n'est pas un effort, c'est votre nature et jusqu'ici on ne vous l'a peut-être jamais demandé comme une qualité professionnelle. Ici, c'est la première.

Vous notez tout, vous planifiez tout, vous vérifiez tout et un board qui n'est pas à jour vous agace. Vous écrivez sans faute et vous relisez par réflexe. Vous avez un bon œil : vous voyez tout de suite quand un visuel est déséquilibré et vous produisez vite sans que la qualité en souffre.

Quand un brief est flou, vous décrochez votre téléphone pour demander des précisions plutôt que de deviner.
Vous êtes à l'aise avec des interlocuteurs qui ont du caractère et qui avancent vite. Vous savez dire, avec le sourire, que ce sera pour jeudi et non pour ce soir, et pourquoi. Devant une salle, vous parlez posément et vous tenez votre position quand on vous pose une question difficile.

About Zego
Insurance hasn’t changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has.
Good drivers are the entire point of Zego. Seven in 10 drivers on the road are consistently good, but until telematics came along there was no way to prove it, so nearly everyone paid a price based on averages. Zego is the company built to change that.
At Zego, we’re leading the AI evolution in insurance.
We move fast, without the layers that usually slow things down. AI takes the routine work off every team, from Finance to Product to Marketing, so people ship real code and launch custom dashboards in minutes.

Engineering commits are entirely AI-assisted, which shifts the focus from team size to the quality of your thinking, and our data warehouse connects directly to an AI assistant for instant answers.

Backed by a modern tech stack (Claude Code, Snowflake, Figma and Zapier) and a commitment to adopting new tools in days rather than quarters, you get complete ownership to do the most impactful work of your career.

We are looking for a part-time, AI first Executive Assistant to provide first class support to the CEO and CFO. This is a role for someone who thrives on variety and can move fluidly between high level strategic support and the practical detail that keeps a fast moving leadership function running smoothly. You will use AI tools as your default way of working, from research and drafting through to automating repetitive administrative tasks.

You will support team activities and meetings, and provide occasional support for offsites and events led by the Leadership team.
You will oversee work-streams as directed, including collating slides, conducting market research, and handling other ad hoc tasks within the scope of the role.
You will manage incoming communications, triaging by priority, drafting replies, and liaising with external parties on the team's behalf, ensuring all correspondence and requests are handled accurately and on time.
You will coordinate Leadership team meetings end to end, including logistics such as video conferencing, venue booking, and offsite travel arrangements, alongside building agendas and presentation materials. This involves close collaboration across internal teams and external parties, and independent research.
You will handle travel management on the occasions the team travels, including flights, rail, hotels, and visas.
You will manage expense processing on behalf of the CEO and CFO, ensuring claims are accurate, timely, and compliant with company policy.
You will attend key meetings as directed by the Leadership team, take thorough minutes, and own the follow-up of action points through to resolution.
You will maintain organisational records and documentation on behalf of the Leadership team, including legal paperwork, passports, and biographies.
What you’ll need to be successful
Have prior EA experience gained in a high change, fast paced startup environment.
Work effectively in a distributed, remote first setup, collaborating fluently via Google Meet.
Have experience managing calendars for multiple team members simultaneously.
Be confident with video conferencing tools, ideally Zoom and Google Meet.
Have excellent IT skills across Google and Microsoft suites.
Have demonstrable AI skills, using tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to synthesise research into decision ready insights, build first drafts of decks and briefing documents, and automate recurring admin so the team's time is protected for what matters most.
Operate one step ahead, knowing the team's diaries inside out, anticipating where they need to be, when, and with the right paperwork in hand.

At Zego, we operate like a high-performing sports team. We come together as one, driven by ambition, backed by real support, and united by a shared mission to win.
Working here means having the backing, the coaching, and an inclusive community of Zegons across the UK and Europe who celebrate your wins and raise your game. It also means holding ourselves to high standards, moving with urgency, taking complete ownership, and embracing honest feedback that helps us continuously learn and evolve.
This is your opportunity for a career-defining experience, and one you will own.
